question: Use calculus to find the behaviour of the function $y=e^x\sin x$, $-\infty<x<+\infty$, and sketch the graph of the function for $-2\pi\le x\le 2\pi$. Show clearly the locations of the maxima, minima and points of inflection in your graph.
